_comment: Maps Clay Audiences industry labels to the ICP keys in icp_weights.json. Built 2026-09-05 from the 2,287 live company records. Unmapped labels fall to 'Other' (8 pts).
_open_question: Intradiem sells across six verticals (Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, Retail, Telecom, Utilities) but icp_weights.industry_points only scores Health Insurance, Financial Services, Banking, Insurance and Healthcare Services. Retail (235 companies), Utilities (194) and Telco/Cable (99) therefore land on 'Other' at 8 points and can never reach Tier 1 on industry. That is a scoring-config decision, not a mapping bug: either add the three verticals to industry_points or accept that they rank low. Flagged, not decided.
